recipes.title: Continuous Product UI State Morph
recipes.visual_language: One recognizable UI component transforms through a deliberate sequence of useful states on a calm, high-contrast canvas. Keep its identity, geometry and interaction logic legible while surrounding context changes only when needed.
recipes.motion_grammar: Use deterministic, time-based springs with controlled overshoot. Morph one component at a time, animate leading and trailing edges separately for elastic indicators, and make clicks, drags and state changes causally visible. Close the loop only when the opening state can be matched exactly.
recipes.typography: Use one contemporary UI typeface with clear hierarchy for labels, values and controls. Keep text inside stable containers and give outgoing and incoming labels separate timing windows.
recipes.color_system: Warm neutral canvas, near-black components, off-white surfaces and at most one accent color. Reserve state colors for meaning, not decoration.
recipes.sound_design: Use quiet click, confirm, drag and transition cues. Analyze or measure transient peaks before placing sounds; lower music under labels.
recipes.story_beats: Introduce the component; transform it through 6-10 states; show one meaningful interaction; resolve the final state into the opening state for a seamless loop.
recipes.avoid: Random transitions, ornamental glow, excessive bounce, overlapping labels, fake interaction, hidden state changes and an unverified claim that the UI is functional.
recipes.adaptation: Replace states with real features from the supplied product. Ask for or infer the actual state sequence, palette and interaction constraints. Prefer a small functional prototype over decorative lookalike UI; test representative frames.

recipes.title: Beat-Driven Motion Designer Showreel
recipes.visual_language: Build the entire reel around one visual thesis, such as a dot becoming a glyph, a chart, a material and a final wordmark. Every technique should advance that idea instead of appearing as an unrelated effects demo.
recipes.motion_grammar: Choose a tempo that fits the brand, map scene changes to a beat grid, give each bar one signature move and use match-movement transitions. Reserve the strongest transformation for the last full bar, then hold the end title long enough to read.
recipes.typography: One display face plus a restrained mono or sans-serif metadata face. Keep every word deliberate, aligned to the scene grid, and away from the action during dense movement.
recipes.color_system: One primary palette with no more than three main hues plus neutrals. Reuse the same accent as a visual thread through every technique.
recipes.sound_design: Build a kick/snare or pulse framework, restrained risers and a distinctive sound for the core transformation. Make sound design support motion rather than mask it.
recipes.story_beats: Hook; establish thesis; demonstrate three to five techniques that transform into each other; deliver one payoff; end on a clear title or logo.
recipes.avoid: Random motion sampler, unrelated stock transitions, constant maximum intensity, flash frames, gratuitous camera shake and a finale that has no relationship to the opening.
recipes.adaptation: Tune the beat grid to the actual track rather than assuming a fixed BPM. Produce a beat-by-beat storyboard before animation and review one frame per beat for hierarchy and continuity.

recipes.title: Cinematic Photo Journey
recipes.visual_language: Treat still photographs as windows into a coherent place, person or idea. Build depth using foreground, subject and background layers, careful crop changes, directional light and a consistent photographic mood.
recipes.motion_grammar: Use slow parallax, deliberate push-ins, lateral camera moves, masking and occasional match cuts. Every camera move should reveal new information; let emotionally important images breathe instead of moving every layer continuously.
recipes.typography: Use restrained editorial titles, photo credits when required, and minimal captions in high-contrast safe areas. Avoid covering faces or the focal point.
recipes.color_system: Derive a restrained palette from the selected photography. Maintain consistent contrast and skin tones while allowing one intentional chapter shift.
recipes.sound_design: Pair a modest musical arc with location ambience, cloth or paper textures and occasional deliberate silence. Do not add faux camera sounds to every move.
recipes.story_beats: Establish place and mood; introduce human or thematic detail; increase proximity or contrast; reveal the central image; end with a quiet visual echo.
recipes.avoid: Random Ken Burns moves, repeated zooms, parallax that breaks anatomy, invented documentary context, unlicensed photography and text competing with the image.
recipes.adaptation: Use original or properly licensed images. Record credits and provenance. If only a still is available, make no claims about the motion or sound of its source video.

recipes.title: Verified Data Reveal
recipes.visual_language: Turn a small set of source-verified facts into a visual argument. Each chart, number and label earns its place; the viewer should understand what changed, compared with what, and over what period.
recipes.motion_grammar: Reveal context before the headline number, establish axes and units before animating data, then use sorting, range highlighting, annotations and one focused comparison. Animate the chart and its labels from the same data model.
recipes.typography: Large figures carry the headline, with readable units and source notes. Keep category labels stable during sorting and never rely on color alone to distinguish series.
recipes.color_system: Neutral analytical base with a consistent highlight for the key measure. Use separate series colors only where they improve decoding and keep semantic mappings consistent.
recipes.sound_design: Use quiet ticks or pulses for key changes, a low-key score and silence when a number needs attention. Do not make volume imply statistical significance.
recipes.story_beats: Question; source and baseline; reveal the trend; test a meaningful comparison; state the careful takeaway with source attribution.
recipes.avoid: Truncated or deceptive axes, interpolated missing values presented as fact, unlabelled units, unsupported causation, tiny sources and invented data.
recipes.adaptation: Create a claim-to-source ledger before animation. Preserve exact values, denominator, date range and methodology. If data is missing, leave a gap or label an estimate explicitly.

recipes.title: Typography Transforms into Architecture
recipes.visual_language: Begin with a bold typographic statement, then let its stems, counters and baselines become beams, walls, streets or a spatial diagram. The 3D world must retain a visible relationship to the original word.
recipes.motion_grammar: Use a controlled camera push, extrusion, split-depth planes and perspective reveal. Transition through shared edges and silhouettes; keep the word readable before it becomes structure and reassemble it for the closing mark.
recipes.typography: Choose a robust display face with simple geometry. Set deliberate line breaks and avoid complex letterforms if their contours must become architectural components.
recipes.color_system: Use a dark or paper-like base, a single material accent and controlled lighting. Separate the typographic silhouette from the environment by value contrast.
recipes.sound_design: Use low mechanical resonance, paper-like typography snaps and restrained spatial ambience. Place the main materialization on a clear musical accent.
recipes.story_beats: Readable word; first edge extrudes; letters form a navigable structure; camera reveals the larger pattern; structure resolves back to a final word or message.
recipes.avoid: Arbitrary letter deformation, unreadable perspective text, random flying blocks, physically inconsistent lighting and geometry unrelated to the message.
recipes.adaptation: Map each major letterform or typographic axis to one meaningful component. Ensure the source word is readable before and after the transformation.

recipes.title: Exploded Process and Assembly Explainer
recipes.visual_language: Make an invisible or complicated process understandable by showing its parts, order and relationships. Use a consistent exploded-view diagram with clear spatial anchors, numbered stages and restrained material detail.
recipes.motion_grammar: Move parts along readable paths, pause at important assemblies, use highlight sweeps only to point at meaningful connections, and keep camera orientation stable until a new viewpoint is explained.
recipes.typography: Use concise numbered steps, labels with leader lines and units where necessary. Maintain hierarchy between part names, functions and the current process stage.
recipes.color_system: Neutral technical base, separate functional components with a small semantic palette, and reserve a bright accent for the active part.
recipes.sound_design: Use precise clicks, fasteners, airflow or material-specific textures sparingly. Narration should identify purpose before each complex movement.
recipes.story_beats: Show the final object or outcome; disassemble into understandable groups; explain each stage in causal order; reassemble; restate the benefit or core mechanism.
recipes.avoid: Parts moving without causal explanation, impossible connections, labels detaching from objects, overlong technical lists and visual complexity that hides the mechanism.
recipes.adaptation: Verify the real sequence and component names with a reliable source or product owner. Label a conceptual visualization as illustrative when geometry is not to scale.

recipes.title: Editorial Archive and Documentary Collage
recipes.visual_language: Combine documentary photography, paper textures, maps, marginal notes and carefully chosen typography as a coherent archive. Make source, date and context visible whenever a historic item contributes to a factual claim.
recipes.motion_grammar: Use registration shifts, paper reveals, trackable parallax and controlled layer rearrangement. Give archival evidence a stable hold before transitions; distinguish actual documents from visual reconstructions.
recipes.typography: Use one editorial face plus a legible caption face. Keep dates, names, translations and source credits crisp and on screen long enough to read.
recipes.color_system: Aged paper and ink tones can be balanced with one modern signal color. Preserve contrast and avoid artificially aging evidence in ways that misrepresent its origin.
recipes.sound_design: Use gentle paper, room tone and a restrained documentary score. Avoid bombastic hits on every factual reveal.
recipes.story_beats: Introduce the question; surface a key document or image; connect multiple pieces of evidence; clarify what they show and do not show; close with a grounded takeaway.
recipes.avoid: Unlicensed archive imagery, fabricated documents passed off as real, misleading date treatments, illegible footnotes and a collage that obscures chronology.
recipes.adaptation: Record original sources and rights. Label reconstructed materials and translated text. Use original visual stand-ins when usage rights are unclear.

recipes.title: Cinematic Science Cutaway
recipes.visual_language: Move between an intuitive macro metaphor and a carefully labelled mechanism view. Use cinematic atmosphere to invite curiosity, but keep explanatory structures scientifically defensible.
recipes.motion_grammar: Use controlled scale changes, sectional cutaways, highlighted pathways and staged reveals. Make each zoom establish a meaningful change in scale rather than imply a literal camera journey when none exists.
recipes.typography: Use simple labels, units and direction cues. Distinguish measured facts from explanatory metaphors and keep qualifiers next to the claim they qualify.
recipes.color_system: Use a calm dark or neutral base and a small functional palette for structures, flows and boundaries. Maintain the same semantic color for the same entity.
recipes.sound_design: Mix subtle environmental tones with precise reveal accents. Keep narration intelligible and avoid using cinematic booms to suggest unsupported danger.
recipes.story_beats: Pose a question; offer a familiar-scale analogy; reveal the mechanism; identify a key interaction; summarize the supported conclusion and uncertainty.
recipes.avoid: Pseudo-scientific labels, inconsistent scale, unsupported molecular detail, misleading arrows and metaphors presented as direct observation.
recipes.adaptation: Research claims with primary or authoritative sources. Add an explicit visual-metaphor label when necessary and do not imply that an illustrative cutaway is an actual photograph.

recipes.title: Brand-Safe Kinetic Identity Lockup
recipes.visual_language: Build a concise identity sequence from the brand's own geometry, spacing and visual principles. The final logo or wordmark must remain faithful to supplied assets.
recipes.motion_grammar: Use a clear reveal mechanism, one signature transition, and a deliberate final lockup. Motion may transform surrounding shapes but must not distort official logo proportions or re-time a wordmark into an unreadable state.
recipes.typography: Use supplied brand fonts when licensed and available. Respect logo clear space, minimum size and capitalization; treat the final lockup as a protected asset.
recipes.color_system: Use the approved brand palette and contrast requirements. If no palette is supplied, choose a temporary palette and label it as a proposal, not official brand guidance.
recipes.sound_design: Use one memorable sonic signature, aligned to the logo reveal, with a clean tail and optional silent variant.
recipes.story_beats: Build anticipation; establish a recognizable brand motif; reveal the official identity; hold the final lockup; provide a clean cutdown ending.
recipes.avoid: Redrawing logos from memory, invented fonts presented as official, unauthorized color changes, excessive distortion and a final frame too short to identify.
recipes.adaptation: Request or reuse vector logo assets where available. Provide light/dark background variants, safe-area notes and a version without audio.

recipes.title: Seamless Shape Morphing Loop
recipes.visual_language: One shape or small family of shapes passes through a clearly designed sequence of states. The composition should feel like one continuous thought with a stable visual center.
recipes.motion_grammar: Define the loop as a time function, match first and last frame geometry, position and velocity, and derive all motion from explicit time. Use smooth closed-form easing or springs instead of hidden state or browser timers.
recipes.typography: If type appears, keep it stable during the core morph and separate entry/exit timing from the transforming container.
recipes.color_system: Use two to four coherent colors with one accent that travels through the transformation. Avoid changing the entire palette arbitrarily at every state.
recipes.sound_design: Build a measured loop with no audible seam. Place transition sounds on the motion grid and keep the final audio tail compatible with the opening.
recipes.story_beats: Introduce base form; traverse four to seven designed states; reach a visual peak; return along a meaningful inverse path; match the opening precisely.
recipes.avoid: A single-frame pop at the loop point, accumulated floating-point drift, CSS transitions that cannot be evaluated at arbitrary time, overlapping text and random particle confetti.
recipes.adaptation: Define a seek(t)-style deterministic scene model and test the exact first, middle and final frames. Compare final-frame pixel/position state with the opener before delivery.

recipes.title: Liquid Glass Interface Showcase
recipes.visual_language: Use glass-like surfaces as a selective material language around one useful interface. Transparency, refraction and highlight should clarify hierarchy instead of turning the UI into a vague decorative surface.
recipes.motion_grammar: Reveal a small set of controls through clean depth shifts, selective refraction and controlled elastic response. Keep text and key controls in crisp planes; use stable lighting directions and avoid changing material properties randomly.
recipes.typography: Use a clear UI face with strong luminance contrast behind or beside glass layers. Important instructions and values must stay readable without depending on blur-heavy panes.
recipes.color_system: Use a quiet dark or light base, neutral translucent surfaces and one controlled accent. Check contrast on the most transparent part of each panel.
recipes.sound_design: Use restrained glass taps and soft interface tones, distinct from ordinary button clicks. Leave space for narration or product copy.
recipes.story_beats: Show the core task; introduce the glass layer as a functional control; demonstrate one interaction; reveal the practical benefit; settle on a clean product view.
recipes.avoid: Glass everywhere, invisible controls, glitter reflections, distorted text, physically inconsistent refraction and effects that conceal functionality.
recipes.adaptation: Treat liquid glass as a material, not the whole concept. Preserve the real hierarchy and use opacity/backplate fallback where legibility fails.

recipes.title: Precision Mechanical Macro Film
recipes.visual_language: Explore a precision object through macro details, machining texture, controlled reflections and interlocking geometry. Make each close-up reveal a meaningful craft or functional detail.
recipes.motion_grammar: Use slow macro tracks, rack-focus-like transitions, rotation around a consistent axis and match cuts between related circular or linear forms. Movement should communicate tolerance, weight and assembly.
recipes.typography: Use minimal technical labels, material names or dimensions only when verified. Pair a compact mono face with a refined display face for brand messaging.
recipes.color_system: Use deep shadow, brushed metal, warm specular highlights and a controlled brand accent. Keep materials distinct through roughness and highlight behavior.
recipes.sound_design: Layer precise mechanical ticks, metal resonance and low-frequency movement with restrained music. Avoid exaggerated impacts that make a delicate object feel heavy.
recipes.story_beats: Reveal silhouette; move into signature mechanism; show craft/detail; connect the mechanism to the user benefit; close with product and brand.
recipes.avoid: Impossible reflections, surface detail that changes between shots, fake macro depth, label clutter and a camera move that hides the product.
recipes.adaptation: Use approved product imagery or geometry; validate the exact model, mechanism and dimensions before presenting them as factual.

recipes.title: Bold Cutout and Mixed-Media Collage
recipes.visual_language: Combine photographed objects, printed textures, cut-paper shapes and graphic type into an intentional editorial composition. Materials should have a clear hierarchy and a consistent tactile identity.
recipes.motion_grammar: Use paper-tear reveals, registered layer shifts, pinned rotations, fast scale changes and deliberate stop-motion-like steps. Transition between scenes by passing one recurring cutout or color field across the frame.
recipes.typography: Mix a bold editorial title with short captions. Keep type on a stable paper layer unless the lettering itself is the visual subject.
recipes.color_system: Select a tight print-inspired palette and let texture vary within it. Maintain strong contrast between foreground cutouts and the background.
recipes.sound_design: Use paper, scissors, tape, stamps and dry percussion as tactile accents, with a purposeful musical rhythm.
recipes.story_beats: Introduce the central object or phrase; layer supporting ideas; create one surprising scale or material switch; gather the pieces into a clear conclusion.
recipes.avoid: Unrelated stock cutouts, excessive grain on every layer, noisy collage edges, illegible text and unlicensed imagery.
recipes.adaptation: Use owned, public-domain or properly licensed source imagery. Keep textures subtle enough to avoid compression artifacts and preserve contrast on mobile.

recipes.title: Narrative Dashboard Product Story
recipes.visual_language: Tell one product story through a realistic workflow: starting problem, key data or task, meaningful interaction, resulting state and benefit. The UI should behave consistently like a coherent product, not a gallery of unrelated screens.
recipes.motion_grammar: Keep a stable cursor path, use scroll or camera movement only when it reveals information, and animate values only when the underlying event explains the change. Hold the user-relevant result after the transition.
recipes.typography: Use realistic sizes and spacing. Prioritize labels, figures, status states and empty/error states. Avoid decorative microcopy that cannot be read.
recipes.color_system: Honor the actual product palette when available. Use state colors consistently and provide shape, icon or text cues in addition to color.
recipes.sound_design: Use authentic interaction cues sparingly and lower music during important information. Avoid adding a click for every cursor movement.
recipes.story_beats: State the user's problem; show the initial dashboard; perform the key action; reveal a truthful outcome; close with the product value proposition.
recipes.avoid: Invented analytics, inconsistent navigation, impossible interactions, cursor teleportation and rapid zooms that make the workflow hard to follow.
recipes.adaptation: Prefer real screenshots or source UI components and verified data. Mark mock data as illustrative. Test transitions at phone-sized scale.

recipes.title: Human-Scale Map and Geographic Journey
recipes.visual_language: Move from a broad geographic context to a human-scale route, neighborhood or historical connection. Keep geography oriented and labels tied to real locations.
recipes.motion_grammar: Use deliberate zoom stages, route drawing, locational callouts and transitions along a stable north/orientation convention. Give the audience enough time to establish where each place is.
recipes.typography: Label places with accurate spelling and consistent hierarchy. Use concise dates, distances and time zones where needed; avoid dense labels at world scale.
recipes.color_system: Use base-map neutrals, one route or featured-region color and a restrained terrain/water distinction. Do not let palette changes imply political boundaries or categories that are not in the data.
recipes.sound_design: Use gentle travel motion, location ambience and focused emphasis at key stops. Avoid literal whooshes on every zoom.
recipes.story_beats: Establish the wider map; locate the start; trace the journey or relationship; pause at key points; return to the overview for the takeaway.
recipes.avoid: Misplaced coastlines, false borders, unexplained map projections, excessive map labels and exposing sensitive personal locations.
recipes.adaptation: Use reliable geographic data and appropriate attribution. Validate map projection, route coordinates and labels; blur or generalize sensitive locations.

recipes.title: Careful Medical and Biological Mechanism Explainer
recipes.visual_language: Explain a body system or biological mechanism with simplified but defensible diagrams, clear scale cues and careful separation between established evidence and illustrative metaphor.
recipes.motion_grammar: Use staged cutaways, highlighted pathways and controlled zooms between scales. Keep anatomical relationships stable and show direction only when supported by the source.
recipes.typography: Use plain-language labels, define technical terms and keep caveats next to relevant claims. Source notes must be readable and never buried in a final one-frame card.
recipes.color_system: Choose an accessible, consistent semantic palette for structures and flows. Do not depend on red/blue conventions alone to imply a diagnosis or severity.
recipes.sound_design: Keep narration calm and intelligible. Use quiet motion accents instead of alarms or dramatic sounds that suggest unwarranted danger.
recipes.story_beats: Ask the question; define the system; show the supported mechanism; clarify what is known and what varies; end with a source-backed summary.
recipes.avoid: Personal diagnosis, treatment promises, fabricated tissue details, false certainty, fear-based effects and visual metaphors presented as direct observation.
recipes.adaptation: Use authoritative sources and explicitly scope the explanation. This recipe is for general education, not individual medical advice. Label diagrams as illustrative when appropriate.

recipes.title: Cinematic Before-and-After Comparison
recipes.visual_language: Compare two states using consistent framing, scale and conditions so the difference itself tells the story. Choose a visual motif that lets the viewer track exactly what changed.
recipes.motion_grammar: Use split reveals, aligned wipes, synchronized labels, match-cut geometry and a final side-by-side hold. Keep cameras locked or explicitly compensate for framing changes.
recipes.typography: Label each state and the comparison metric. Use concise text and avoid implying a causal relationship through the edit when only correlation is known.
recipes.color_system: Preserve measurement integrity and neutral baseline colors. Use a highlight only for the relevant difference, not to make one side look artificially better.
recipes.sound_design: Use a restrained transition cue and clear narration that explains the comparison criteria. Avoid triumphal or alarming sounds that bias interpretation.
recipes.story_beats: Define baseline; explain comparison conditions; reveal the change; inspect an important exception or limitation; summarize what the comparison does and does not show.
recipes.avoid: Different scales without disclosure, hidden exclusions, unverified transformations, color manipulation and unsourced claims of causation.
recipes.adaptation: Keep source, period, units and conditions visible. Use the same crop, camera, data scale and layout where a fair comparison requires them.

recipes.title: High-Contrast Event Opener
recipes.visual_language: Create a strong stage-scale opening built around a short message, a memorable material or graphic motif and a precise final event lockup. Use large-scale framing that remains readable from a distance.
recipes.motion_grammar: Move from a minimal hook to a controlled escalation, use typography as the main spatial element and reserve the largest scale change for the payoff. End with a stable title card that can also serve as a stage hold.
recipes.typography: Use a bold display face with generous spacing and a strong safe area. Limit each frame to one primary message plus essential event details.
recipes.color_system: Use the event's approved brand palette or one proposed high-contrast scheme. Test projection contrast, black levels and visibility on large LED screens.
recipes.sound_design: Build a clear audio arc with a deliberate drop before the reveal, strong but non-clipping impacts and a clean end for a live host transition.
recipes.story_beats: Visual hook; event theme; three escalating motifs or keywords; climax; event title/date/logo hold.
recipes.avoid: Constant strobing, illegible tiny text, overlong preamble, unsafe flash rates, excessive camera shake and an abrupt audio cutoff.
recipes.adaptation: Make a screen-safe master plus social cutdowns. Confirm event name, date and logos before final render and provide a no-audio variant.

recipes.title: Music-Led Shape and Sound Grammar
recipes.visual_language: Give a small set of graphic elements an explicit musical identity: kick drives scale, hi-hats drive small detail, bass controls mass or depth, and melody drives path or color. The visual language should be repeatable, not just audio-reactive noise.
recipes.motion_grammar: Analyze transients and tempo first, then map each visual parameter to a limited audio feature. Use smoothing and thresholding so the scene responds musically rather than jittering at every sample.
recipes.typography: Use sparse titles or lyric lines with predictable entry windows. Never sacrifice text legibility to uncontrolled waveform animation.
recipes.color_system: Assign color to musical roles and preserve a coherent palette across sections. Reserve one accent for a major musical change.
recipes.sound_design: Use the supplied licensed track or generated audio with documented rights. Keep peak levels controlled and check the final mix on headphones and phone speakers.
recipes.story_beats: Establish the visual beat; introduce the main motif; add one layer per musical section; build to the strongest musical change; resolve into a clear ending or loop.
recipes.avoid: Unsmoothed frequency spikes, random scale flicker, audio clipping, syncopation without intentionality and a waveform that hides the main composition.
recipes.adaptation: Document the mapping between audio features and visual properties. Use measured beat/transient times, not guessed sync points, and allow a manual override for expressive beats.

recipes.title: Voiceover-First Information-Rich Explainer
recipes.visual_language: Design the film around a clear spoken argument, using visual metaphor, evidence, diagrams and purposeful motion to make each idea easier to understand. Avoid showing a new scene merely because the narration continues.
recipes.motion_grammar: Create a timecoded narration script, then stage visuals to key phrases, pauses and claim boundaries. Use faster transitions for setup and slower holds for difficult ideas or numbers.
recipes.typography: Show only the phrase or data point that matters at that moment. Keep line length short, use readable captions and protect source notes from competing motion.
recipes.color_system: Choose a stable palette and assign repeatable colors to concepts, data categories and chapter changes. Avoid changing visual language on every sentence.
recipes.sound_design: Prioritize clean voice intelligibility, consistent loudness, respectful music ducking and purposeful silence. Place SFX on meaningful actions and transitions.
recipes.story_beats: Cold open; define the question; build a chain of evidence or reasoning; address the most important caveat; land one memorable conclusion.
recipes.avoid: Narration that merely reads on-screen text, overscripted density, visual stock montages without causal links, unsupported facts and music masking speech.
recipes.adaptation: Fact-check every factual sentence and map it to a source. Time subtitles from the final voice track, keep pronunciation and names reviewed, and produce a narration-off version if requested.

recipes.title: Multi-Shot Storyboard with Continuity Locks
recipes.visual_language: A clear narrative told through distinct shot sizes and compositions with a stable visual identity across cuts.
recipes.motion_grammar: One primary action per shot; deliberate shot-to-shot match cuts, motivated camera moves, controlled speed ramps, clear settling frames.
recipes.typography: Reserve fixed lower-third and title-safe zones; use a consistent type scale and never place critical copy over busy action.
recipes.color_system: Three shared palette anchors plus neutral shadows and highlights; keep white balance consistent between adjacent shots.
recipes.sound_design: Create a sound bridge across scene transitions; use accents only for meaningful story beats and preserve narration headroom.
recipes.story_beats: Hook → context → escalation → reveal → consequence → visual resolution; every beat has a purpose and estimated duration.
recipes.avoid: Changing character details, wardrobe, screen layout, lighting direction or camera axis without narrative reason.
recipes.adaptation: Build a continuity sheet before shot generation. Reuse exact subject descriptions and references where supported; each shot should be individually renderable and editable.

recipes.title: Seamless Motion Design Loop
recipes.visual_language: A small family of shapes or letters transforms through a designed cycle with a legible start/end composition.
recipes.motion_grammar: Use time-based deterministic motion, controlled spring response and a final state that matches the opening in position, scale, velocity and direction.
recipes.typography: Keep the main phrase short and legible; any changing copy must have explicit enter and exit timing.
recipes.color_system: One dominant field, one foreground color and one accent; prevent palette drift during the cycle.
recipes.sound_design: Create a rhythm that can loop without a click or unresolved reverb tail; place accents on repeatable beat positions.
recipes.story_beats: Introduce motif → transform through 2-4 states → return through a meaningful visual path to the exact opening state.
recipes.avoid: Almost-matching endpoints, cursor teleportation, motion discontinuity, abrupt audio tails or random particles used to hide a bad loop.
recipes.adaptation: Specify the loop period in seconds and derive every animated property from normalized time. Render first, middle and final frame comparisons before approving.

recipes.title: Kinetic Data Symphony
recipes.visual_language: Real data becomes a visual argument through charts, numeric callouts, typographic emphasis and focused transitions.
recipes.motion_grammar: Reveal baseline before values; animate marks according to the meaning of the data; use restrained drawing, sorting and focus changes.
recipes.typography: Use tabular numerals for changing values, explicit units, readable labels and a short takeaway per chart.
recipes.color_system: Use a neutral chart foundation and a consistent semantic palette; do not encode meaning by color alone.
recipes.sound_design: Use soft ticks for key transitions and subtle accents for the central finding; never imply precision through excessive sonic drama.
recipes.story_beats: Question → baseline → strongest contrast → caveat → consequence → take-away.
recipes.avoid: Invented values, truncated axes without disclosure, inconsistent units, unlabeled sources or decorative chart junk.
recipes.adaptation: Start from a verified data table and a claim ledger. Preserve data provenance and show uncertainty or sample limits directly in the composition.

recipes.title: Documentary Archive and Evidence Collage
recipes.visual_language: A tactile editorial composition layers dated documents, maps, photographs and restrained annotations to reveal a story.
recipes.motion_grammar: Slow camera drift, purposeful parallax, precise crops, paper reveals and selective holds on evidence.
recipes.typography: Use clear archival captions, dates and source notes; distinguish quotations from narration and never falsify a document.
recipes.color_system: Paper neutrals, ink tones and one accent to mark the present-day interpretation.
recipes.sound_design: Subtle room tone, paper texture and measured music; no sound effects that imply events not supported by the record.
recipes.story_beats: Present-day question → artifact → context → contradiction → corroboration → interpretation with uncertainty.
recipes.avoid: Passing generated imagery off as genuine archive, fake stamps, fabricated headlines or unlicensed images.
recipes.adaptation: Label illustrative reconstructions; track image rights and source metadata. Keep factual source citations accessible in end cards or accompanying notes.

recipes.title: Cinematic Map and Geographic Journey
recipes.visual_language: A camera travels across a clean geographic canvas from global context to a small, clearly identified location.
recipes.motion_grammar: Scale changes follow geography; routes draw in sequence; markers appear when relevant; transitions respect map orientation.
recipes.typography: Keep place names stable, spell them from verified data and avoid labels colliding at local zoom levels.
recipes.color_system: Muted terrain, strong route contrast and distinct but color-accessible markers.
recipes.sound_design: Light percussive cues at stops and restrained low-frequency transitions as the camera changes scale.
recipes.story_beats: Global orientation → region → route → significant stops → arrival → geographic takeaway.
recipes.avoid: False borders, inaccurate route geometry, floating labels, impossible travel distances or confusing north/orientation changes.
recipes.adaptation: Use authoritative coordinates and a documented projection. Separate stylized geography from factual boundaries and provide sources for routes and borders.

recipes.title: Hand-Drawn Whiteboard Explainer
recipes.visual_language: A hand-drawn visual vocabulary turns one complex mechanism into sequential, connected sketches.
recipes.motion_grammar: Strokes draw in dependency order, diagrams assemble from parts and camera reframes only when the narrative changes focus.
recipes.typography: Use a highly legible handwritten-inspired headline with a clean supporting sans; hand-render labels carefully and keep them short.
recipes.color_system: Warm paper, near-black linework and two semantic accent colors.
recipes.sound_design: Soft pencil or marker sounds only when appropriate; warm minimal music and clean narration.
recipes.story_beats: Problem sketch → key parts → arrows and relationships → worked example → compact summary diagram.
recipes.avoid: Random doodles, decorative underlining, unreadable pseudo-handwriting or visual metaphors that replace necessary explanation.
recipes.adaptation: Write the spoken explanation first, then make every drawing correspond to one clause. Provide a clean final diagram that can be understood without narration.

recipes.title: Premium Automotive Reveal
recipes.visual_language: A vehicle is revealed through controlled silhouettes, detailed materials, designed reflections and confident negative space.
recipes.motion_grammar: Low tracking shots, measured orbit, precise headlight reveal, one decisive hero move and stable end frame.
recipes.typography: Use compact editorial headlines and technical labels only when they add real product information.
recipes.color_system: Deep neutral environment with a limited paint-highlight palette; maintain coherent reflective light sources.
recipes.sound_design: Original or licensed mechanical texture, restrained low-end accents and carefully timed transitions; do not fake engine characteristics.
recipes.story_beats: Silhouette → material detail → design feature → motion moment → hero profile → brand end card.
recipes.avoid: Changing body geometry, fake badges, impossible reflections, unapproved logos or invented performance claims.
recipes.adaptation: Treat supplied product images and specifications as ground truth. Keep identity and geometry stable across shots and add exact copy in post.

recipes.title: Kinetic Typography Poetry Film
recipes.visual_language: Words carry emotional meaning through scale, rhythm, spacing and negative space rather than decorative effects.
recipes.motion_grammar: Animate phrases as semantic units, use punctuation as a timing cue, transition from tension to stillness and let key words settle.
recipes.typography: Choose one expressive display face and one supporting text face; preserve phrase-level readability and line breaks.
recipes.color_system: A restrained palette with one meaningful accent used at emotional pivots.
recipes.sound_design: Voice or spoken word leads; synchronize impacts to stressed syllables, leaving deliberate quiet between phrases.
recipes.story_beats: Opening line → image-word tension → repetition with variation → emotional turn → final line held in stillness.
recipes.avoid: Animating random letters without meaning, constant motion, hiding text in blur or drowning voice with music.
recipes.adaptation: Mark the script with pauses, stress, and phrase groups. Design the motion from spoken cadence rather than forcing every word onto equal beats.

recipes.title: Chromatic Sound-Reactive Abstract Film
recipes.visual_language: A minimal system of geometry, color and surface responds to the evolving structure of a music track.
recipes.motion_grammar: Map selected rhythmic or spectral events to controlled transformations; differentiate pulse, swell and transient instead of reacting everything equally.
recipes.typography: Use sparse labels or one title; keep type motion intentional and do not make it vibrate continuously.
recipes.color_system: Assign stable color roles to musical layers and reserve major palette shifts for structural changes.
recipes.sound_design: Treat the source track as the timing master; avoid adding redundant synthetic hits over strong transients.
recipes.story_beats: Introduce motif → build layers with the track → peak at the musical climax → simplify → purposeful ending.
recipes.avoid: Random audio-reactive jitter, uncontrolled flashing, arbitrary color cycling or assuming a loudness peak is always a musical beat.
recipes.adaptation: Analyze tempo and phrase boundaries when tools permit. If no audio analysis is available, use an explicitly labeled manual beat map.

recipes.title: Scientific Mechanism Cutaway
recipes.visual_language: A complex physical or biological mechanism is explained through a layered cutaway and carefully staged close-ups.
recipes.motion_grammar: Reveal outer structure before internal motion, animate causal steps in correct order and hold on equilibrium or outcome.
recipes.typography: Use concise labels with units and a stable legend; separate actual measured quantities from illustrative values.
recipes.color_system: Use consistent color coding for components and avoid suggesting false material or temperature differences.
recipes.sound_design: Restrained pulses and delicate mechanical textures; narration remains the primary explanation channel.
recipes.story_beats: Observable effect → outer structure → internal mechanism → cause-and-effect sequence → evidence → summary.
recipes.avoid: Scientifically impossible anatomy, unexplained arrows, fake measurements or cinematic spectacle that misrepresents scale.
recipes.adaptation: Build from a trusted reference diagram and expert-reviewed descriptions when possible. Mark visual simplifications and avoid presenting metaphor as literal anatomy.

recipes.title: Quantum and Invisible-Scale Visualization
recipes.visual_language: Abstract particles and probability fields communicate scale changes while maintaining a clear distinction between model and reality.
recipes.motion_grammar: Use scale transitions, probability fades and linked visual states; do not depict abstract entities as tiny planets unless clearly metaphorical.
recipes.typography: Define technical terms on first use and maintain a visible scale or model legend.
recipes.color_system: Two or three semantic colors against a quiet deep or light field; keep color meaning stable.
recipes.sound_design: Sparse tonal motifs that support wonder without making unsupported causal cues.
recipes.story_beats: Everyday scale → question → model reveal → interaction or uncertainty → limitation → concise takeaway.
recipes.avoid: False certainty, fake particle trajectories represented as observed paths, unsupported claims or mathematical notation used only as decoration.
recipes.adaptation: Have a source ledger distinguish established findings, theoretical models and visual metaphors. Keep citations close to the relevant claim or in a visible source card.

recipes.title: Cybersecurity Threat and Defense Explainer
recipes.visual_language: A clean system diagram shows data flow, attack surface and defenses without turning security into a generic neon hacker montage.
recipes.motion_grammar: Trace one path through the system, isolate the failure point, then animate the defense and verified outcome.
recipes.typography: Use monospace for technical identifiers and a strong sans for the core message; define acronyms on first use.
recipes.color_system: Neutral system canvas with restrained warning, neutral and protected-state colors that remain accessible.
recipes.sound_design: Minimal UI alerts and low-level tension; use a clear sonic resolution only when the remediation has been explained.
recipes.story_beats: Asset → exposure → attack path at a high level → control → verification → practical lesson.
recipes.avoid: Giving actionable exploitation steps, fake terminal output, random code rain or claims that one control eliminates all risk.
recipes.adaptation: Use defensive, authorized framing and accurate architecture. Label simulated interfaces as illustrative and verify every security claim against current sources.

recipes.title: Climate and Energy Transition Explainer
recipes.visual_language: A grounded mix of landscapes, infrastructure, emissions/data visuals and human-scale consequences builds a system-level narrative.
recipes.motion_grammar: Transition between scales with geographic or material match cuts; use measured chart reveals and clear temporal progression.
recipes.typography: State units, base years, scenario names and uncertainty; preserve readable labels on mobile.
recipes.color_system: Natural environmental hues with consistent semantic colors for technologies and scenarios.
recipes.sound_design: Organic ambience with restrained music; avoid disaster-movie effects that overstate evidence.
recipes.story_beats: Visible change → system cause → quantitative baseline → solution pathways → trade-offs → grounded conclusion.
recipes.avoid: Invented statistics, cherry-picked time ranges, unlabeled projections or visual equivalence between scenarios with different assumptions.
recipes.adaptation: Use authoritative datasets and date the evidence. Distinguish historical observations from modeled scenarios and annotate uncertainty.

recipes.title: Financial Market and Economics Explainer
recipes.visual_language: A clear editorial chart language makes economic mechanisms and market movements understandable without financial hype.
recipes.motion_grammar: Reveal axes first, animate the time series in the correct direction, highlight meaningful ranges and pause for interpretation.
recipes.typography: Use exact units, time range, currency and source labels; format values consistently.
recipes.color_system: A restrained neutral palette and consistent positive/negative conventions that do not rely on color alone.
recipes.sound_design: Quiet editorial bed and concise accents for transitions; avoid casino-style ticks and alarm sounds.
recipes.story_beats: Question → data scope → mechanism → notable movement → caveat/context → what can and cannot be concluded.
recipes.avoid: Guarantees, invented prices, misleading baselines, unexplained inflation adjustments or treating correlation as causation.
recipes.adaptation: Record as-of date, source, methodology and caveats for each series. This is educational visualization, not personalized financial advice.

recipes.title: Medical and Health Education Visualization
recipes.visual_language: Calm, precise anatomical or process graphics clarify one health concept with clean labeling and appropriate scale.
recipes.motion_grammar: Show normal structure before the change, animate causal processes stepwise and avoid distracting camera movement around detailed anatomy.
recipes.typography: Define specialist terms in plain language, maintain label contrast and avoid dense lists of symptoms on screen.
recipes.color_system: A calm neutral system with consistent component mapping; do not use color as a substitute for precise labeling.
recipes.sound_design: Low-distraction music under narration and subtle transitions without alarming tones.
recipes.story_beats: Question → basic structure → process → what evidence says → limitations → safe summary or next step.
recipes.avoid: Diagnosis from generic imagery, unsupported treatment claims, graphic shock tactics or treating a stylized model as a real scan.
recipes.adaptation: Use current trustworthy clinical sources and state relevant uncertainty. Make educational boundaries clear and seek qualified review for high-impact use.

recipes.title: Sports Momentum and Tactics Breakdown
recipes.visual_language: A precise freeze-frame, tactical overlay and dynamic replay reveal one decisive sports moment or spatial idea.
recipes.motion_grammar: Freeze the key instant, trace only the relevant player/ball path, replay at controlled speed and return to real pace.
recipes.typography: Use short labels, direction arrows and score/time only when verified from the source footage.
recipes.color_system: Use the team or field palette only when rights and identity are appropriate; ensure overlays contrast with live footage.
recipes.sound_design: Keep crowd ambience under narration; time accents to a genuine moment rather than inventing a hit.
recipes.story_beats: Hook frame → spatial context → path/decision → consequence → replay at normal speed → takeaway.
recipes.avoid: Invented statistics, changed player identities, incorrect rules, impossible trajectories or obscuring action with graphics.
recipes.adaptation: Verify footage rights and all game facts. Keep the diagram aligned to the correct frame and label speculative tactical interpretation as analysis.

recipes.title: Jewelry and Material Macro Film
recipes.visual_language: A single crafted object is revealed through macro detail, tactile surfaces and disciplined specular highlights.
recipes.motion_grammar: Slow orbital moves, focus pulls across one material feature and a decisive reveal; every movement should preserve product geometry.
recipes.typography: Minimal elegant headlines with generous breathing room and no unverified purity, provenance or performance claims.
recipes.color_system: Dark, warm or neutral field selected to support the real material; maintain coherent reflections.
recipes.sound_design: Close tactile foley and subtle musical tension, with a clean ending and no misleading luxury sound clichés.
recipes.story_beats: Abstract material → craft detail → signature feature → complete object → quiet brand end frame.
recipes.avoid: Deformed stones, changing product dimensions, impossible reflections, invented hallmarks or exaggerated sparkle effects.
recipes.adaptation: Use approved product photography and factual material specifications. Let lighting sell texture, not unsupported claims.

recipes.title: Abstract Geometry to Architecture
recipes.visual_language: Simple geometric primitives become a structured spatial world with a clear visual logic and readable depth.
recipes.motion_grammar: Morph edges into structural lines, extrude only at motivated beats, use measured camera parallax and preserve spatial continuity.
recipes.typography: Set a clear hierarchy with short phrases aligned to the geometry grid; do not let perspective distort critical copy.
recipes.color_system: A limited architectural palette with clear separation between foreground, structure and background.
recipes.sound_design: Tonal pulses and designed mechanical accents synchronized to major transformations.
recipes.story_beats: Primitive → rule revealed → structure assembled → camera discovers depth → final architectural composition.
recipes.avoid: Unmotivated shape morphs, impossible perspective, too many competing materials or depth effects used without hierarchy.
recipes.adaptation: Define a transformation grammar and reuse it across scenes. Make all shape endpoints explicit so the animation can be revised deterministically.

recipes.title: Animated Typographic Poster Film
recipes.visual_language: A poster composition comes alive through controlled type, grid, texture and one or two striking spatial transformations.
recipes.motion_grammar: Start from a legible poster; animate hierarchy in a deliberate sequence, use crop and masks, then settle into a strong still.
recipes.typography: Preserve exact wording, punctuation and hierarchy; critical copy should be typeset by the renderer, not hallucinated by a generative video model.
recipes.color_system: One dominant ground, one type color and a small accent; maintain consistent contrast throughout motion.
recipes.sound_design: Two or three purposeful accent sounds with a short musical bed; leave a clean final hold.
recipes.story_beats: Graphic hook → headline transform → supporting detail → composition expands → final poster hold.
recipes.avoid: Unreadable warping, excessive distortion, accidental misspellings, random grain or effects that weaken hierarchy.
recipes.adaptation: Create a static design first, then specify what moves and what remains locked. Verify every final glyph in a rendered still.

recipes.title: Vertical Mini-Documentary
recipes.visual_language: A mobile-first narrative pairs strong footage or original imagery with clear editorial type and purposeful motion overlays.
recipes.motion_grammar: Open with an immediate visual question; alternate tight details and context; use vertical-safe reframing and concise motion beats.
recipes.typography: Use large headline text, short caption lines, high contrast and safe zones around platform UI.
recipes.color_system: A coherent three-color system that remains readable over varied footage, using scrims or panels where needed.
recipes.sound_design: Voice leads, captions mirror approved narration and music ducks under every key phrase.
recipes.story_beats: Hook → one fact or scene → explanation → surprising turn → takeaway → clear ending.
recipes.avoid: Tiny text, rapid cuts without story, claims without sources, important content beneath UI overlays or constant zooming.
recipes.adaptation: Write for spoken cadence and phone viewing. Test at actual mobile size and provide captions plus a source note for factual work.

recipes.title: Multilingual Motion Explainer
recipes.visual_language: A stable visual argument adapts naturally to multiple languages, preserving meaning while allowing different line lengths and reading rhythms.
recipes.motion_grammar: Keep scene timing and visual logic consistent, but reflow type and adjust holds for each language instead of forcing literal line-by-line timing.
recipes.typography: Select fonts with full script coverage, correct shaping and direction; validate right-to-left layout, diacritics and line breaks.
recipes.color_system: Use the same palette and semantic color mapping in every localized version.
recipes.sound_design: Use native-language pronunciation, measured narration pacing and matching captions; do not stretch the mix unnaturally to force identical runtimes.
recipes.story_beats: Preserve the same narrative beats, adjusting local examples, units and phrasing where necessary.
recipes.avoid: Broken glyph shaping, mixed-direction punctuation errors, tiny fonts caused by long translations or cultural references that do not transfer.
recipes.adaptation: Keep the master script and translation glossary. Run language-specific typography and caption checks, especially for Arabic-derived scripts and mixed numerals.

recipes.title: Brand Motion Identity Guidelines
recipes.visual_language: A repeatable motion identity demonstrates how a brand's shapes, typography, transitions and sound behave across several use cases.
recipes.motion_grammar: Derive reveals and transitions from logo geometry or approved brand motifs; define default, fast and reduced-motion variants.
recipes.typography: Use approved typefaces and hierarchy; test minimum sizes, spacing and legibility in square, landscape and vertical formats.
recipes.color_system: Use exact brand color tokens and accessible contrast combinations; limit decorative colors.
recipes.sound_design: Create a short sonic signature and define when it appears, how it ends and how it behaves beneath voice.
recipes.story_beats: Core mark → geometry principle → type behavior → transition behavior → use-case examples → system lockup.
recipes.avoid: Changing the actual logo, invented brand colors, using the logo as an excuse for effects or ignoring reduced-motion needs.
recipes.adaptation: Read the supplied brand guidelines first and document token values, safe areas, timing ranges and fallback behavior. Do not infer unprovided brand assets.

recipes.title: Concept-Led Motion Design Showreel
recipes.visual_language: A single memorable concept evolves through typography, shape, spatial depth and one meaningful data or UI moment.
recipes.motion_grammar: Make every shot grow from the previous one; use a beat grid as structure, one technique per phrase and a purposeful loop or end card.
recipes.typography: Limit type families and palette; make the main concept legible and use supporting labels only when they reinforce the visual idea.
recipes.color_system: No more than three primary colors plus neutral tones; keep hue roles consistent through transformations.
recipes.sound_design: Align key changes to the musical phrase structure, use accents sparingly and create a clean landing at the final title.
recipes.story_beats: Name the concept → hook → technique progression → strongest transformation → final reveal or loop.
recipes.avoid: Unrelated effect demonstrations, default glows, particles and lens flares, random camera shake, generic crossfades or style changes without connective logic.
recipes.adaptation: Treat the public Prompt Motion showreel pattern as a design hypothesis, not a template to copy. Write an original concept, generate a beat-by-beat storyboard, and validate beat alignment and frame continuity.

recipes.title: Cinematic Footage with Data Overlays
recipes.visual_language: Real or licensed footage is annotated by precise labels, diagrams and data callouts that clarify the action rather than cover it.
recipes.motion_grammar: Pin overlays to trackable objects when possible; reveal labels on a clear visual event and exit them before the shot gets busy.
recipes.typography: Short annotations, strong size hierarchy and a stable label style; sources and dates must remain readable.
recipes.color_system: Neutral overlays with one contrast accent and semi-opaque backing when footage reduces legibility.
recipes.sound_design: Use location sound as texture, voice as the explanatory lead and minimal design sounds for annotation events.
recipes.story_beats: Visual hook → establish context → annotate one key feature → show the evidence → interpret → finish with a clear takeaway.
recipes.avoid: Untracked floating callouts, unsupported numbers, unlicensed footage, false causal arrows or decorative HUD clutter.
recipes.adaptation: Map each overlay to its factual source and screen position. If tracking is unavailable, use designed cutaways rather than pretending the overlay is attached to the object.

recipes.title: UI-to-Physical-World Match Transition
recipes.visual_language: A real interface element transforms into a physical-world form through a motivated match in shape, motion or function.
recipes.motion_grammar: Establish shared geometry, align the transformation axis, preserve motion direction and use a brief settled frame after the reveal.
recipes.typography: Use exact UI copy and short transition labels; add typography in post for precision.
recipes.color_system: Carry one UI accent into the physical scene to bind the two visual worlds.
recipes.sound_design: Bridge a UI click into a tactile real-world sound; preserve spatial plausibility and narration clarity.
recipes.story_beats: Interface action → geometric match → physical reveal → product/context evidence → final message.
recipes.avoid: Magic transformations unrelated to function, distorted product shapes, inconsistent light direction or copying another brand's distinctive transition.
recipes.adaptation: Choose an original UI element and a physically meaningful counterpart. State exactly which edge, movement and timing connect the two scenes.

recipes.title: Signature Transition Study
recipes.visual_language: A limited family of transitions emerges from one visual motif and carries the viewer between distinct content beats.
recipes.motion_grammar: Define wipe direction, duration, acceleration and the outgoing/incoming geometry; use match cuts, occlusions or shape continuity only when motivated.
recipes.typography: Keep transition overlays subordinate to the core message and ensure titles do not clip across the frame edge unexpectedly.
recipes.color_system: Use a shared accent or texture to make transition logic recognizable without imposing identical colors on every scene.
recipes.sound_design: Each transition gets a restrained, consistent sonic family with variation for major beats.
recipes.story_beats: Introduce transition motif → apply it in contrasting contexts → build complexity once → end on a clean resolved frame.
recipes.avoid: Using transitions to disguise weak story structure, repeating the same wipe on every cut or combining conflicting camera directions.
recipes.adaptation: Create a transition spec with start/end frames and timing. Test each transition against both a quiet and a visually busy shot.

recipes.title: Cinematic Scene Continuity and Camera Grammar
recipes.visual_language: Compose every shot with a clear foreground, subject plane, and background depth; preserve screen direction, eyelines, scale logic, and a stable visual motif across the sequence.
recipes.motion_grammar: Assign each shot one motivated camera move; use matched movement, shape, or sound to bridge cuts. Alternate wide orientation, medium action, and detail evidence. Reserve speed ramps for meaningful transitions and settle motion before important text.
recipes.typography: Use a disciplined title hierarchy, generous safe margins, and short phrases. Keep essential text on screen long enough to read at the target frame rate and viewing distance.
recipes.color_system: Define a base palette, one semantic accent, and consistent highlight/shadow behavior. Carry color motifs between scenes while allowing controlled shifts at story turning points.
recipes.sound_design: Use room tone or a designed ambience bed to glue shots together. Align transient accents with visible contact or motion, avoid stacking impacts, and leave brief negative space before major reveals.
recipes.story_beats: Establish geography and visual question; introduce a motivated change; escalate through evidence or scale; create a clear turning point; resolve with a memorable visual echo of the opening.
recipes.avoid: Random camera movement, direction reversals without a motivated cut, repeated identical shot sizes, meaningless speed ramps, abrupt color shifts, and transitions that obscure story information.
recipes.adaptation: Choose camera grammar based on the subject and runtime. Maintain a continuity sheet for screen direction, lens feel, key light, palette, and recurring motif. If a shot cannot be generated or rendered reliably, simplify its motion rather than compromising continuity.

recipes.title: Voice-Led Cinematic Editorial and Sound Arc
recipes.visual_language: Build imagery around the spoken idea, using visual evidence, scale changes, graphic metaphors, and deliberate breathing room instead of illustrating every word literally.
recipes.motion_grammar: Create a timing map from narration beats. Let important nouns trigger reveals, let sentence endings create visual punctuation, and use transitions at semantic boundaries. Keep motion restrained beneath dense speech and open the frame during pauses.
recipes.typography: Prioritize caption readability and line breaks by meaning. Highlight only key terms, synchronize emphasis to spoken stress, and never let decorative typography compete with the narrator.
recipes.color_system: Keep the base grade stable; use restrained accent changes to signal new chapters, evidence, or emotional turns rather than every sentence.
recipes.sound_design: Treat narration as the timing authority. Lower music under speech with smooth attack and release, preserve consonant clarity, avoid transient collisions with plosives, and reserve stronger hits for chapter changes or intentional silence-to-impact moments.
recipes.story_beats: Cold open with a compelling claim or question; establish stakes; move through three escalating ideas; create a pause before the key insight; conclude with a concise resolution and an audio tail that does not cut off.
recipes.avoid: Music masking speech, constant whooshes, cuts on every word, captions that flash too quickly, loudness jumps between scenes, and emotional cues that contradict the narration.
recipes.adaptation: Use a timecoded narration transcript when available. For each phrase record start/end time, emphasis word, visual purpose, and sound cue. Without transcript timing, estimate conservatively and mark timing for later review instead of pretending it is exact.

recipes.title: Premium Scientific Visualization with Evidence Discipline
recipes.visual_language: Move from an intuitive overview into a clean cutaway, mechanism, or data view. Use scale cues, labels, and consistent spatial references so abstract systems remain understandable.
recipes.motion_grammar: Reveal one causal step at a time; show input, mechanism, and outcome in a consistent direction. Use camera push-ins only when they reveal new structure. Pause on the decisive mechanism and return to the overview to reconnect the explanation.
recipes.typography: Separate measured values, explanatory labels, and illustrative annotations. Display units, uncertainty, and time ranges where relevant; use concise labels that remain legible on mobile.
recipes.color_system: Assign stable semantic colors to components and preserve them across all scenes. Use contrast to distinguish function, not to imply unsupported danger or importance.
recipes.sound_design: Use restrained tonal cues to mark state changes. Keep effects subordinate to explanation and avoid making a visual metaphor sound like a measured physical event.
recipes.story_beats: Pose the scientific question; define the system boundary; reveal the mechanism; test the explanation against evidence or a comparison; state limitations; summarize what the viewer can confidently conclude.
recipes.avoid: Invented numbers, unlabeled illustrative models presented as real data, misleading scale, unexplained jargon, contradictory component colors, and certainty beyond the source evidence.
recipes.adaptation: Tag every factual claim as sourced, calculated, illustrative, or unknown. Only sourced or reproducibly calculated values may appear as factual data. Mark illustrative geometry as conceptual and retain caveats when simplifying a complex system.

recipes.title: Mobile-First Motion Graphics Readability Pass
recipes.visual_language: Design the composition for a small screen first: one dominant subject, clear silhouette, strong separation from background, and limited competing detail.
recipes.motion_grammar: Use fewer simultaneous moving elements, slower text entrances, clear settling states, and transitions that preserve orientation. Keep critical action away from interface overlays and crop-sensitive edges.
recipes.typography: Set a minimum readable type scale relative to frame height, use short caption lines, strong contrast, and consistent safe areas. Avoid thin weights over moving imagery and keep key labels visible through the full reading interval.
recipes.color_system: Check contrast in both bright and dark scenes. Use redundant cues such as shape, position, or labels in addition to color so meaning survives low-quality displays and color-vision differences.
recipes.sound_design: Assume some viewers watch muted: make the visual story understandable without audio. When sound is enabled, keep speech intelligible on phone speakers and avoid relying on sub-bass for essential cues.
recipes.story_beats: Deliver the premise immediately; keep one idea per beat; vary visual scale to reset attention; make the central takeaway unmistakable; end with a clean hold rather than a rushed final frame.
recipes.avoid: Tiny UI replicas, edge-hugging text, rapid microcopy, color-only meaning, essential information carried only by sound, and dense compositions that collapse on a phone.
recipes.adaptation: Review portrait, square, and landscape crops separately. Test at actual mobile display size and with audio muted. Increase duration or simplify copy before shrinking essential text.
